description: This file implements middleware functions for authentication in a Node.js application, including extracting Bearer tokens, deriving user identities, loading user data from a database, and attaching authentication context to requests.

methods.name: getBearerToken
methods.description: Extracts Bearer token from request headers.

methods.name: deriveIdentityFromToken
methods.description: Derives user identity information from a simple token pattern.

methods.name: loadUserFromDb
methods.description: Loads a user document from the database based on provided identity info and headers.

methods.name: attachAuthContext
methods.description: Middleware that attaches req.user with user info if a Bearer token is present.

methods.name: requireAuth
methods.description: Middleware that enforces authentication by checking req.user.
